description: This file declares functions and structures related to commit reachability and merge base calculations within a version control system (likely Git). It includes function prototypes for repository operations, commit list processing, and reachability analysis, as well as related enums and macros.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases
methods.description: Finds common ancestors (merge bases) of two commits in a repository.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Finds merge bases for multiple commits against a single commit.

methods.name: repo_get_merge_bases_many_dirty
methods.description: Similar to 'repo_get_merge_bases_many', but marks the commits as dirty after operation.

methods.name: get_octopus_merge_bases
methods.description: Calculates merge bases for multiple commits, possibly for octopus merges.

methods.name: repo_is_descendant_of
methods.description: Checks if a commit is a descendant of another.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases
methods.description: Checks if a commit is in the merge bases of the repository.

methods.name: repo_in_merge_bases_many
methods.description: Checks if a commit exists in merge bases with multiple references.

methods.name: reduce_heads
methods.description: Removes commits that are reachable from others in a list, reducing redundancy.

methods.name: reduce_heads_replace
methods.description: Replaces the list of commits with its reduced form to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: commit_contains
methods.description: Determines if a commit contains other commits based on filter criteria.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach_with_flag
methods.description: Checks reachability with specific flags and constraints.

methods.name: can_all_from_reach
methods.description: Determines if all commits in one list are reachable from another with optional cutoff.

methods.name: get_reachable_subset
methods.description: Returns subset of commits reachable from a set of 'from' commits to 'to' commits.

methods.name: ahead_behind
methods.description: Computes ahead/behind counts for commit comparisons.

methods.name: tips_reachable_from_bases
methods.description: Marks tips reachable from specified base commits.

methods.name: get_branch_base_for_tip
methods.description: Finds the branch base closest to a given tip among multiple bases.
